# Imhof and Wallimann bid-rigging tender data

Wallimann, H. (2021). *Detecting bid-rigging coalitions in different countries and auction formats*, Version 1. Mendeley Data, [doi:10.17632/x8jwmbcpgn.1](https://doi.org/10.17632/x8jwmbcpgn.1), CC BY 4.0. The data were prepared for Imhof and Wallimann (2021), *International Review of Law and Economics* 68, 106016: Swiss road-construction tenders (with predicted values added), tenders from Okinawa, Japan, and Italian public works tenders, each with the bids of every firm and a flag for tenders inside a known cartel period.

## Consumer contract

`Medium-Blog/bid-rigging-screens` downloads `Swissdata_addpred.csv`, `Japanesedata.csv` and `Italiandata.csv` and checks each against the SHA-256 that Mendeley Data publishes for the file (recorded in `metadata.yaml`). The upstream files use CRLF line endings.

## Why the bytes are not mirrored

The versioned Mendeley Data record is the authoritative, checksummed byte source.
